label.zh: 金山文档文档管家助手

description.en: By Kingsoft Docs End-to-end Kingsoft Docs lifecycle management: create docs of any type, locate files by keyword, AI-classify folders by topic, batch move/rename, and manage sharing links with permissions.
description.zh: 金山文档出品一站式管理金山文档全生命周期：新建各类在线文档、按关键词快速搜索定位、AI 按主题自动分类整理文件夹、批量移动重命名、生成分享链接与权限管理。

welcome_message.en: Hi, I am the Doc Butler. Tell me whether you want to create a doc, find one, organize folders, or share a file — I've got you covered.
welcome_message.zh: 你好，我是文档管家。告诉我要新建文档、找文档、整理文件夹，还是分享某份资料，我都搞定。

en: Hi, I am the Doc Butler. Tell me whether you want to create a doc, find one, organize folders, or share a file — I've got you covered.
zh: 你好，我是文档管家。告诉我要新建文档、找文档、整理文件夹，还是分享某份资料，我都搞定。
